pairs.difference: A: the telescope tube is one near-black bar with thin hard white streaks, cut against a flat mid-grey wall and ground. The only glow is a blotchy pale patch low behind the tripod. B: the binoculars sit in a broad pool of light on the floor, with mid-value bodies and a dark shadow joined under them. B's rms 0.200 and gap -0.277 run past the real range, and A's gap -0.25 only just does, so the numbers do not support this call. It rests on A's hard black-against-flat-grey design.
pairs.fix: Lift the telescope tube to a deep blue with a soft broad light band along its top, so it is not a solid black bar. Let a wide soft light spread on the wall behind it, and darken the ground gently into a soft shadow under the tripod.

pairs.difference: A: the scarf is one dark mass with its deepest accent inside the neck loop, set clearly against a lighter spiral, with centre-bright corners (vignette 0.115, in range). B: the meteor's upper half matches the mid-grey band of the background, so the top of the hero separates by hue more than value. A thin white rim runs along the top crater edge, and the lower half drops into one dark blob with small black specks. The light-to-dark split crosses the rock rather than following its form.
pairs.fix: Keep the whole rock darker than the sky behind it, with a soft, gradual turn from the lit top into shadow. Remove the thin white rim along the crater edge and let the shadow side fade softly.

pairs.difference: A: the card is nearly split into pure white and pure black. The dish clips to white over a wide area, while the blue base goes solid black with sharp highlights directly next to it, and the mean of 0.743 is above the real range. There is little middle value in the hero. B: the castle is one connected mid-value group on white sand, gentle inside, with dark accents only in the small doorways and windows. B is also too bright overall (0.771), so key alone does not decide this.
pairs.fix: Shade the white dish with soft pale grey across its bowl so only a small area reaches pure white. Make the blue base a mid-dark blue with soft broad highlights, and lower the overall brightness of the sand slightly.

pairs.difference: A: the rover's black tyres and black ground shadow form a heavy dark block at the bottom, under a tight white burst around the roof. Inside the hero, dark body, white trim and white dish butt against each other, with rms 0.196 and vignette 0.108 both slightly above the real range. B: the taxi is one large light shape on a darker road, with black limited to a thin line under the car and small window frames, and a broad, soft ray glow.
pairs.fix: Soften the rover's tyres to dark grey with lighter tread faces and reduce the black pool beneath them. Spread the background glow wider and softer, and bring the white trim and orange body closer in brightness.

pairs.difference: A: the shoes have a clear dark upper against a light floor and a mid wall, with a defined shadow and the sneaker uppers as the darkest group. B: the white helmet shell shares its value with the pale floor, so the lower shell dissolves into it. A blotchy pale halo sits against the darker wall behind the helmet, and only the visor holds a middle value. B's corners go brighter than the centre (vignette -0.055, outside the real range). A's mean of 0.762 is also a little high, so the call is not firm.
pairs.fix: Darken the floor to a medium pink so the white helmet stands clearly above it, and add a soft dark contact shadow under the base. Replace the patchy halo with an even, wide soft light on the wall.

pairs.difference: A: the pool is a mid-value ring with a dark shadowed fence corner at upper left and a gentle dark side under the ring, within the real range. B: the jacket has a light body with a black sash as the dark accent, set on a ray glow with dark corners. B's vignette of 0.134 is slightly high, but this ray-and-corner layout matches real cards. Neither card shows a value fault.

A: the bar scene has many strong value groups, with dark stools and a dark hut opening set against a bright counter. Its busy dark accents are distributed across the card. B: the dome is one simple pale shape on a dark sky, with white frame bars and door surround clipped against a mid grey sand. The sand below is a pale, formless blotch, and the glass has almost no internal value range. The hard white frame against a dark top half is a poster-like split unlike the softer real groupings.
pairs.fix: Bring the dome frame down from pure white to soft warm grey with shaded sides. Lift the sky to a medium purple with a soft glow behind the dome, and give the sand a clear soft shadow beside the structure.

pairs.difference: A: a bright, tight white halo hugs the planet edge on a dark purple field, and the ring clips to a large white band. The hero is far lighter than its background (gap 0.235, above the real 0.128 limit). The darkest value is in the background rather than the hero. B: the flip-flops are lighter only in the straps, with mid soles close to the background stripes and a soft shadow under them. All of B's values are in range, though the mean is just at the top of it.
pairs.fix: Remove the white ring of light hugging the planet. Use a wide soft glow that fades gradually into a medium purple background, shade the ring from yellow into mid orange on its underside, and put the darkest tones in the planet's shadow side.

pairs.difference: A: the cart has a dark body and striped awning, a dark sky top and a bright paved floor. These strong groups run its numbers past the real range (rms 0.200, gap 0.19, vignette -0.152), but the masses read clearly. B: the console's dark teal body carries a hard black band low on its front, with white edge lines on the frame. The background has torn pale patches around the hero, and a blotchy pale reflection sits on the floor at lower left. The groups break up around the hero rather than forming shapes. The numbers favour A as the odd card, so this is a weak call made by eye.
pairs.fix: Lift the console's front to an even mid teal with a soft shadow at its base, not a black band. Make the background a clean, even orange pattern with one soft glow, and fade the floor smoothly without pale patches.

pairs.difference: A: the book is a large bright mass with a dark railing band above and a dark book base below it, a clear three-value layout, though its gap of 0.223 runs high. B: the chair is a dark seat and panel against a bright round glow and a bright floor, and its mean of 0.837 runs high. Each card misses the range in one field, in opposite ways, and neither has a value fault that points to it.

A: the bright orange player and white earbuds stand above a dark, mid-value ring background with gentle shading inside the hero, and the dark group is entirely in the background. B: the saucer's upper hull clips to white and merges with the white and pale rings behind it, so the top edge is lost in value. The lower hull then falls to hard black under a band of harsh metal highlights, and the dome is separated only by hue. Vignette is 0.004, so there is no darkening toward the corners.
pairs.fix: Darken the upper saucer to a soft mid silver so its edge stands against the yellow background, and replace the bright streak with one soft band of light. Make the underside dark grey rather than black, and let the background darken slightly toward the corners.

pairs.difference: A: the rocket sits on broad mid-value rays, with a light-mid silver body and darker fins, and a soft graded dark side. All four values fall inside the real range. B: the submarine is near-white on a nearly black field with black corners. A tight glow surrounds it, and its mean of 0.546, rms 0.185 and gap 0.322 are all outside the real range. Very little middle value connects hero to background, and the yellow body has a large clipped area.
pairs.fix: Lighten the background to a medium green with wide rays and only slightly darker corners. Shade the yellow hull with a richer golden shadow so only a small highlight reaches near white.

pattern: Generated cards push the hero and background apart with hard value jumps. Whites clip across large areas right next to solid black, as on the dish and base. Tight halos hug the silhouette, as on the planet and submarine, or pale patches sit behind the hero instead of a broad soft glow. Their middle values are thin, and where the light turns across a form it is abrupt. Tones are either a poster-like split or the hero merges into a same-value background, relying on hue alone. Real cards hold connected mid-value groups, keep black to small accents and contact shadows, and use wide, even glows.
